benin.title: Flag of the Republic of Benin

colors.note: Hoist-side vertical band representing hope and the palm groves of the south.
Upper fly band symbolising the northern savannas and the country's wealth.
Lower fly band honouring the courage of the ancestors.

desc:
- A green vertical band on the hoist side, with two horizontal bands of yellow over red on the fly
- The colours are Pan-African and trace back to the flag first adopted at independence in 1959
- Reinstated in 1990 after the end of the Marxist-Leninist People's Republic of Benin
trivia:
- Originally adopted on 16 November 1959, replaced in 1975, and restored on 1 August 1990
- One of the earliest African flags to use the Pan-African green-yellow-red palette
- The country was known as Dahomey until 1975 before being renamed Benin
